name: theme
body: A theme: a project-defined (`templates/themes/<name>/`) named set of CSS variable tokens (colours, fonts, spacing) in `theme.css`, plus theme-owned files (fonts, logos) in its directory that theme.css references by relative url() (served from the theme dir; not reachable via the layout `media` helper, which resolves only under templates/media/). No built-in themes; deck-wide; omitted selection resolves to the project's `default`.
